label: Now Developing
items: The House impeached VP Sara Duterte 257–25–9 on May 11 — first official impeached twice; articles are now before a Senate where Alan Cayetano ousted Tito Sotto hours earlier.
Senator Bato dela Rosa evaded an ICC arrest warrant after gunshots at the Senate on May 13; he left the building May 14 while the Ombudsman suspended the sergeant-at-arms.
Luzon and Visayas faced three days of red-alert brownouts (4,160 MW offline) as Mayon’s lava collapse sent a 4,000m ash plume over Albay with 70,000+ families affected.
